title: A/R Summary lists a customer who only has a credit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has no open invoice and one unused $40.00 credit memo.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Find customer X.
  4. Read customer X's Total.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • customer X is listed.

Step 4:

  • Total $-40.00.

Why this matters: Customer credits must be visible when reconciling.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalAccountReceivableCustomerFetcher.php:276-280. V1 code, quoted: `'EXISTS ('.$invoiceSub.') OR EXISTS ('.$creditSub.') OR EXISTS ('.$depositSub.')'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-041) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
